name: 21842 · Ocean City, MD
findings: ZIP 21842 (Ocean City) has 52 nonprofit organizations. 24 of them (46%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 21 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 21842 (Ocean City) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 21842 (Ocean City) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.1 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 21 organizations here; 21% of all organizations here have no identified type.
